note: Pinned OpenClaw supply for the Hub channel verticals (plan §14.4: public npm, no mirror; the integrity pin is the trust boundary for pinned supply). Each channel pins the shared main package + its own channel package. Integrity is the tarball `dist.integrity` (npm `sha512-…`); the channel packages additionally pin `gitHead` (the main package does not record one on the registry). Telegram is inlined in the main package's dist (no separate channel package), so its `channel` pins the main package itself (file:// URL, no alias surface — plan §7 / table-top finding #0). Slack and Telegram are pulled IN-REPO (blueprint docs/audits/2026-08-26-in-repo-channel-verticals.md §6.5): their loadMode is `in-repo` and the Hub drives the built workspace package (`inRepoPackage`) — trusted first-party, no tarball fetch, no integrity gate at load; the `channel` pins stay as the UPSTREAM SYNC REFERENCES (integrity + gitHead intact) for the re-sync loop.
